issues.description: Hydration error: server renders different text than client. Console shows 'Server: Which room are we designing? Client: A few quick questions' mismatch. The header subtitle text differs between SSR and client render, causing full root hydration failure and client-side re-render.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx, the header section likely uses some dynamic/conditional text or references state/context that differs between server and client render. The server renders 'Which room are we designing?' while client renders 'A few quick questions', suggesting the component reads from a store or context that isn't available during SSR.

issues.description: Wrong question content displayed: step-3 should show style quiz with image comparison pairs, but instead shows 'How do you prefer your surfaces?' with text options - this is step-1 content. The progress shows 'Question 1 of 3' which is also wrong for step-3.
issues.root_cause: The step-3 page component likely reads question index from a client-side store (e.g. Zustand) that initializes at 0 on both server and client, but the server doesn't have access to the persisted state. The component falls back to question 0 instead of the correct step-3 question.

issues.description: Missing image comparison pairs: expected behavior for step-3 is 'Two room images side by side for preference selection' but only text buttons are shown with no images.
issues.root_cause: Either the step-3 page is incorrectly configured to show text-only questions, or the question data for this step doesn't include image pairs. The component may be rendering the wrong question set entirely due to the hydration/state issue.

fixes.reason: Ensure client-only hooks are available for suppressing hydration mismatch

Fix the header subtitle to match what should be shown on step-3 (style quiz), eliminating the server/client text mismatch. The server was rendering 'Which room are we designing?' while client rendered 'A few quick questions' - using a consistent static string resolves hydration error.
